name: World Wide Love! -Sekai Seifuku Kanojo Fandisc-
original_name: World Wide Love! 世界征服彼女ファンディスク
source:
This is the fandisc to the Navels’ 2010 title Sekai Seifuku Kanojo. Contains after stories for all 5 original heroines and will include a route for Yoshiko who was a sub-character in the original game.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/21/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Liemyx's Blog[/url]]
translation:
本作是Navel于2010年推出的《世界征服彼女》的资料片，收录原作五名女主角的后日谈，并为原作配角花之宫良子新增路线。

[译自 [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/21/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Liemyx's Blog[/url]]
